categoryTaxonomy.bass: Low-frequency foundation in a supporting role (sub/low-mid, 40-250Hz); root-focused, non-melodic
categoryTaxonomy.melodic_bass: Bass-register instrument carrying melodic phrases (log drum, sliding/gliding 808 lines, synth-bass leads)
categoryTaxonomy.drums: Kit drums, breaks, drum machines, claps/snaps, and orchestral percussion (timpani, taiko, concert percussion)
categoryTaxonomy.world_perc: Unpitched or rhythm-function hand percussion: hand drums, shakers, scrapers, ethnic non-kit percussion
categoryTaxonomy.guitar: Guitar-family instruments (acoustic, electric, nylon, pedal steel, resonator/dobro)
categoryTaxonomy.strings: Bowed and plucked strings outside the guitar family (violin family, erhu, kora, guzheng, pipa, banjo, mandolin, dulcimer)
categoryTaxonomy.keys: Keyboard-, mallet-, and reed-layout pitched instruments (piano, Rhodes, organ, clavinet, accordion, bandoneon, marimba, glockenspiel, kalimba/mbira)
categoryTaxonomy.synth: Synthesized leads, pads, basses and textures with no primary acoustic-instrument target
categoryTaxonomy.horns: Brass — French horn, trombone, tuba, mixed brass sections, and synth-brass patches
categoryTaxonomy.trumpets: Brass — trumpet, flugelhorn, cornet, and trumpet-led sections
categoryTaxonomy.saxophones: Saxophone family (soprano, alto, tenor, baritone), acoustic or emulated
categoryTaxonomy.winds: Woodwind and free-reed wind instruments (flutes, single/double reeds, pan flute, ocarina, harmonica, melodica)
categoryTaxonomy.vocals_choir: Sung or spoken vocal layers: backing stacks, choirs, chants, vocal chops, talkbox
categoryTaxonomy.fx: Non-musical production elements: risers, impacts, scratches, noise textures, ambience, delay throws

categoryClassificationRules: Emulation follows target: a synth patch emulating an acoustic family classifies as that family (synth-brass → horns, synthesized sax → saxophones, synth-trumpet → trumpets). Only target-less patches go to synth.
Tuned mallet/lamellaphone → keys: marimba, glockenspiel, kalimba, mbira, balafon.
Bass register + melodic phrases → melodic_bass; root/sub support → bass. Slides/glides/riffs imply melodic_bass.
Claps, kit, machines, timpani → drums; unpitched hand percussion → world_perc. Tuned hand drum in a lead-bass role (log drum) → melodic_bass.
Brass split: trumpet family → trumpets; everything else and mixed sections → horns.
Guitar vs strings: guitar-family only in guitar; all other bowed/plucked strings (including banjo, mandolin, kora, guzheng) → strings.
